scenarios.title: A｜普通联系
scenarios.setting: 分手几个月后，玩家突然收到前任的消息。

turns.text: Hey. It’s been a while. How have you been?

turns.prompt: 关于「前任再次联系」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Hey. I’ve been pretty good. How about you?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey. I’ve been pretty good. How about you?
feedback.explanation: “I’ve been”把过去的经历或持续情况与现在联系起来，适合交代背景。

choices.text: Hi. Yeah, it has been a while. I’m doing okay.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi. Yeah, it has been a while. I’m doing okay.
feedback.explanation: “has been”把过去开始的状态与现在联系起来，常用于说明持续情况或经历。

choices.text: I’m doing well, thanks. I wasn’t expecting to hear from you.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m doing well, thanks. I wasn’t expecting to hear from you.
feedback.explanation: 用简短感谢接住对方的帮助或答复，表示已经收到这份好意。

choices.text: Hey. Is everything okay?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hey. Is everything okay?
feedback.explanation: 用疑问句核对刚谈到的状态或条件，给对方确认和更正的机会。

turns.text: Yeah, everything’s fine. I just thought about you the other day and wanted to see how you were doing.

turns.prompt: 你想表达支持和祝愿，会怎么说？

choices.text: That’s nice of you. I hope you’ve been doing well too.

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s nice of you. I hope you’ve been doing well too.
feedback.explanation: “nice of you”用来感谢或肯定对方的好意，重点在对方做出的体贴举动。

choices.text: I’m doing okay. A lot has changed since we last talked.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m doing okay. A lot has changed since we last talked.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: Thanks for checking in. What have you been up to lately?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for checking in. What have you been up to lately?
feedback.explanation: “up to”谈限额时表示最多达到某个数量，适合确认包含的额度。

choices.text: I appreciate the message, but I’m not really comfortable staying in touch.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate the message, but I’m not really comfortable staying in touch.
feedback.explanation: 先感谢来信，再说明继续联系让自己不自在，拒绝明确而不需要攻击对方。

turns.text: I understand. I didn’t mean to make you uncomfortable.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thanks for understanding. I think some distance is better for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for understanding. I think some distance is better for me.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: No hard feelings. I just think it’s better if we move on separately.

feedback.naturalExpression: No hard feelings. I just think it’s better if we move on separately.
feedback.explanation: “no hard feelings”表示不会因此记恨对方，常用于缓和拒绝或分歧后的气氛。

choices.text: I appreciate that. Take care of yourself.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate that. Take care of yourself.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

turns.text: Would you be willing to meet up sometime? Maybe just for coffee?

turns.prompt: 你想在答应见面前了解对方想谈什么，会怎么说？

choices.text: Maybe. What did you want to talk about?

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe. What did you want to talk about?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: I’m not sure. Why do you want to meet?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure. Why do you want to meet?
feedback.explanation: 用于邀请或商量，先确认对方是否愿意，再决定后续安排。

choices.text: I think I’d be okay with that, as long as we’re clear about what it is.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I’d be okay with that, as long as we’re clear about what it is.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I’d rather not meet in person. I hope you understand.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather not meet in person. I hope you understand.
feedback.explanation: “I hope”表达希望而非保证，适合祝愿或说明对后续的期待。

choices.text: Why do you suddenly want to see me again?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe. What did you want to talk about?
feedback.explanation: 这句可以询问动机，但“suddenly”可能带出戒备；若想了解来意，平和地问为什么想见面即可。

turns.text: There’s nothing dramatic. I’d just like to talk and catch up.

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. I could meet for coffee sometime this weekend.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I could meet for coffee sometime this weekend.
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: All right, but I’d prefer to keep it casual.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right, but I’d prefer to keep it casual.
feedback.explanation: 把选择说成自己的偏好，可以表明立场，而不必否定另一种选择。

choices.text: I’m still not sure that’s a good idea for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m still not sure that’s a good idea for me.
feedback.explanation: “I’m still not sure”说明疑虑尚未消除，避免让对方误以为自己已经同意。

choices.text: Could we just talk here instead?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could we just talk here instead?
feedback.explanation: “Could I / we …?”礼貌提出自己的需求或征求许可；这里不是在说过去的能力。

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: Saturday afternoon works for me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Saturday afternoon works for me.
feedback.explanation: 明确表示接受刚提出的方案，让对方知道可以按这个安排继续。

choices.text: Sure. How about the café near the station?

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. How about the café near the station?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Okay. Let’s keep it to coffee and see how it goes.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Let’s keep it to coffee and see how it goes.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

scenarios.title: C｜希望复合
scenarios.setting: 见面后，前任告诉玩家自己想重新开始。

turns.text: I’ve had a lot of time to think about us. I still have feelings for you, and I’d like to try again.

turns.prompt: 你想表达对重新开始这段关系的犹豫，会怎么说？

choices.text: I still care about you too, but I’m not sure getting back together is a good idea.

feedback.naturalExpression: I still care about you too, but I’m not sure getting back together is a good idea.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

choices.text: I wasn’t expecting you to say that. I need some time to think about it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I wasn’t expecting you to say that. I need some time to think about it.
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Part of me wants that too, but we’d have to talk about what would actually be different this time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Part of me wants that too, but we’d have to talk about what would actually be different this time.
feedback.explanation: “have to”表示有必要或受条件限制必须这样做，可用于核实办理要求。

choices.text: I’m sorry, but I don’t want to get back together.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m sorry, but I don’t want to get back together.
feedback.explanation: “get back together”表示复合，问的是是否恢复恋爱关系，而不只是再见一面。

choices.text: You want to become lovers again?

feedback.naturalExpression: I still care about you too, but I’m not sure getting back together is a good idea.
feedback.explanation: “become lovers again”过于生硬；复合常用“get back together”，问句也应补上“Do”。

turns.text: I know I made mistakes. I really think things could be different now.

turns.prompt: 你想在考虑复合前了解这次可能有什么不同，会怎么说？

choices.text: What do you think would be different this time?

feedback.naturalExpression: What do you think would be different this time?
feedback.explanation: “what do you think”邀请对方给出意见，不替对方作决定。

choices.text: We’ve said that before. What has actually changed?

feedback.naturalExpression: We’ve said that before. What has actually changed?
feedback.explanation: 围绕一个具体动作或情况提问，让对方针对这一步确认或解释。

choices.text: If we tried again, I wouldn’t want us to fall into the same patterns.

feedback.naturalExpression: If we tried again, I wouldn’t want us to fall into the same patterns.
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

choices.text: I hear what you’re saying, but feelings alone aren’t enough for me to try again.

feedback.naturalExpression: I hear what you’re saying, but feelings alone aren’t enough for me to try again.
feedback.explanation: “I hear what”强调听进了对方的说法，并不等于完全同意。

turns.text: I’ve worked on a lot of things since we broke up. I don’t expect you to decide right now.

turns.prompt: 你想回应对方的帮助或安排，表达谢意，会怎么说？

choices.text: I appreciate that. I do need some time to think.

feedback.naturalExpression: I appreciate that. I do need some time to think.
feedback.explanation: “I appreciate”表达对帮助、坦诚或付出的感谢，后面点明感谢对象更具体。

choices.text: Thank you. I don’t want to make this decision based only on how I feel right now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. I don’t want to make this decision based only on how I feel right now.
feedback.explanation: 从自己的感受说明影响，把需要讨论的重点说出来，避免直接替对方判断动机。

choices.text: Maybe we can keep talking, but I don’t want to promise anything yet.

feedback.naturalExpression: Maybe we can keep talking, but I don’t want to promise anything yet.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: I understand, but my answer is still no. I think we should move on.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand, but my answer is still no. I think we should move on.
feedback.explanation: “I understand”承认听懂了对方的理由或难处，为继续协商提供基础。
